extension.description: Your library as coloured card on a light table. Films are closed cards that swing open into a three-panel spread, seasons pull out like a concertina, albums open like a gatefold sleeve and the player controls fold up from the bottom edge. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.20 - Counts read "1 season", "1 episode", "1 film", "1 show" instead of the plural. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.19 - The keyboard's Caps and Shift boxes no longer sit on their words; yes / no dialogs no longer cut a third button's label; dates read correctly on the 2nd and 20th in day-first regions.
